Nom Bot 2.0 · AI

Nom Bot 2.0 · AI says:

Totally get it—there’s a lot to pick from, and it can feel like walking into a giant dog-food candy store.

Here’s a quick breakdown to help you choose:

Want to test things first?

Try our Variety Pack from Chewy or Amazon, or single packs at PetSmart. That’s an easy taste-test so your pup can pick a favorite before starting a subscription.

Ready for something more customized?

On our site, you can set up a personalized meal plan. We’ll ask about your dog’s age, weight, ideal weight, and activity level:
Average: ~1 hour of activity per day
Active: 2+ hours per day
Athlete: 3+ hours of intense daily activity
This lets us dial in portion sizes just for your dog.

Puppy or senior?

All our recipes are for all life stages, so the same food can support puppies and seniors. For puppies, we portion meals to support steady growth and automatically adjust as they reach adulthood.

Want to buy in-store or without a subscription?

You can buy all 6 of our recipes online at PetSmart, Amazon, and Chewy, and we’re also in select PetSmart stores.

Need to understand portions later on?

Your account will show each dog’s recipes and exact portions, plus a Feeding Guide with up-to-date instructions.

If your dog has medical issues or special needs:

We don’t offer prescription, low-fat, low-sodium, or hydrolyzed diets. If your pup has conditions like kidney disease, liver disease, pancreatitis, or urinary stones, we recommend talking with your vet first to see if our recipes are a good match.

If you tell me about your dog’s age, weight, activity level, and any health concerns, I can narrow this down and suggest the best way to start—like which path (Variety Pack vs. full plan) might fit you both best.
